callout_caught: %s is caught with a card up the sleeve and thrown out. The hand is void.

callout_wrong: Nothing turned up. That went down badly
callout_wait: Nobody will take another accusation from you for a while
callout_no_hand: Wait for a hand to be in play
npc_join_4: Mind if I sit? My money spends same as yours.
npc_join_5: Heard the cards were running hot at this table.
npc_greet_friend_2: Well, if it ain't %s. My favourite benefactor.
npc_greet_friend_3: %s! Sit, sit. Your money's always welcome here.
npc_greet_grudge_1: %s. I've been waiting for a chance to win my money back.
npc_greet_grudge_3: Keep an eye on %s, folks. Lucky as a horseshoe.
npc_greet_known_2: %s. Good to see a familiar face.
npc_win_big_3: Drinks are on me. Well, one drink.
npc_win_big_4: Lady Luck's sweet on me tonight.
npc_win_big_5: I'll just take these, thank you kindly.
npc_lose_big_2: That one's going to sting in the morning.
npc_lose_big_3: Who shuffled this deck, the devil?
npc_lose_big_4: My wife's going to skin me alive.
npc_lose_big_5: Hmph. Enjoy it while it lasts.
npc_allin_3: Let's see what you're made of.
npc_drunk_2: Is it my turn? It's my turn. Is it?
npc_drunk_3: I love you fellas. I mean it.
npc_drunk_5: These cards keep movin' on me.
npc_leave_bust_2: Not a cent left. Good night.
npc_leave_profit_1: Quit while you're ahead, my pa always said.
npc_leave_profit_2: I'll take my winnings and go, thank you.
npc_leave_profit_3: That'll buy a fine supper. Evening, all.
npc_leave_night_1: I'm calling it a night. You've had enough of my money.
npc_leave_night_2: You've cleaned us out, friend. We're done.
npc_leave_night_3: That's enough cards for one evening.
npc_leave_room_1: I'll give up my seat. Good luck, folks.
npc_leave_storm_2: To hell with all of you!
npc_leave_storm_3: I don't have to sit here and take this.
npc_caught_1: Now hold on, I can explain—
npc_offended_1: You calling me a cheat? Watch your mouth.
npc_offended_2: Say that again and we'll settle it outside.
npc_offended_3: I'll pretend I didn't hear that.
